title: The cabin and the serpant.
content: okay I had this crazy dream a few years ago and its a place I've visited often. It's a cabin in the middle of the mountains at night. The moon is full and the back of the cabin faces out to a lake sat in between the mountains. Its night time but its very lit and the vibe is comforting and nostalgic. There is a dock that leads from the cabin directly to the lake. Okay now to get into this dream. I was hiking to the cabin and when I got there i immediately went to the dock where there was a boat, i got in the boat and started rowing into the lake i remember looking back and seeing the beautiful cabin peaking out in between the tree line. Then glancing at the mountain peaks and the moon n stars, I started to look down at the water and noticed something glowing was under me. It looked like a bioluminescent serpant, it shot out of the water and headed to the stars as soon as it got to the atmosphere the serpant split in two and went the opposite way of eachother. It wrapped around the world and once the two serpants met eachother again one serpant ate the other making a circle around the world the it turned into a constellation. This dream shook me to my core. I remember waking up from that dream feeling like i experienced something otherworldly. I ended up looking into what i saw and found a symbol of a serpant eating its tail called ouroboros. I am certain the imagery i saw was about this symbol. Before this dream though i have never seen nor heard of ouroboros. I am a witch though and im also native so I was certain that this dream meant something big. Looking into it the symbol stands for cycles, life and death and rebirth. Have any of you had a similar experience?
